rationale.conceptual: Standard computational chemistry workflow: DFT single-point, QTAIM, and Hirshfeld surface analysis are established methods applied with documented parameters; no novel algorithms, only routine use of Multiwfn and CrystalExplorer.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline (geometry extraction, two DFT levels, QTAIM, CrystalExplorer energy frameworks) with dependencies between steps, requiring proper tool installations, file format conversions, and careful parameter orchestration.

difficulty.reasoning: The task reproduces published QTAIM and Hirshfeld calculations using standard tools and public crystal structures; conceptual difficulty is low, execution involves a multi-tool workflow but nothing beyond typical computational chemistry pipeline.

compute_estimate.reasoning: DFT single-point calculations on three isolated organic molecules (60-80 atoms) at B3LYP/6-311++G(2df,2pd) and 6-31G(d,p) levels; typical memory under 8 GB per calculation; no GPU needed; input CIF files negligible.
